tools.name: query_knowhow
tools.description: Search this person's real, grounded skills/experience graph for a topic using semantic search. Returns only entries with real evidence -- never guesses. tools.name: list_by_type
tools.description: Returns the COMPLETE, exact set of entries for one type, with no similarity ranking, no relevance cutoff, and no cap on count. tools.description: Given an exact tag/skill (e.g. 'docker', 'gcp'), returns EVERY entry with that tag, uncapped, grouped by type with a real count per type. findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "skill_evidence" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
